subject: Proposed reporting shift for Core Serving (confidential)
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed reporting shift for Core Serving (confidential)

Team —

I want to share an initial proposal for a small reporting and scope shift inside Core Serving. This is confidential for now — we need HR + leadership input before any comms. High level: 

- Move "Model Serving Reliability" (4 ICs + 1 lead) from Platform Runtime to Core Serving Product (reporting to Marcus).
- Split the current "Performance & Cost" scope into a dedicated Cost Optimization lead (new role) and a smaller perf team that remains with Platform Runtime.
- Re-evaluate two senior ICs for potential manager-of-IC (M2IC) spots; tie that decision to the Q4 performance calibration.

Why: reduces cross-team handoffs for inference SLA ownership, consolidates paging/rotation, and aligns cost incentives. Risks: compensation parity, potential manager overload during transition, and temporary gaps on on-call.

Attached: redline_proposal_v1.docx and headcount_model.xlsx — both drafts. Please review for: legal/comp concerns (Monica), operational continuity/on-call impact (Marcus), and performance review timing implications (Neha).

Ask: can you respond with your top 3 concerns and any hard blockers by EOD Wednesday (Aug 12)? I plan to consolidate feedback and run a 30-minute review with Aditya and Laura on Thursday.

Thanks — Rafael

--
Rafael Mendes
Director, Product Operations
Redwood Inference
rafael@redwood.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proposed reporting shift for Core Serving (confidential)

Thanks for the heads-up, Rafael — appreciate the confidential flag. Quick read + HR lens below.

Top concerns:  
1) Compensation/grade parity: moving people between orgs can trigger comp regrades or off-cycle adjustments. We need job-family mapping and a before/after grade table for each affected headcount.
2) Performance review timing: if we designate potential M2IC roles in Q4, we need clear success criteria and an interim plan for calibration so promotions don't conflict with ongoing reviews.
3) Employee experience / manager capacity: any added reports to Marcus must include a 3-month transition plan; if Marcus would be >8 direct reports consolidated, we should evaluate a split or interim ladders.

Requested docs for HR review: the headcount_model.xlsx (please add current job codes), role descriptions for the new Cost Optimization lead, and any proposed manager transition timelines. Also provide a list of anyone under PIP or with active performance concerns — we may need separate handling.

Legal/notice: if there are changes to official reporting lines we need to document effective dates and send opt-in/consultation notices for exempt employees in the EU. That will affect comms cadence.

I can pull comp parity analysis and a communications template by Wednesday EOD. Recommend we include Aditya for leadership sign-off and PeopleOps Consulting if we decide to bring an external facilitator for sensitive 1:1s.

Subject: Re: Proposed reporting shift for Core Serving (confidential)

Appreciate the summary, Rafael. From an operational POV my quick notes: 

- On-call: the Reliability lead currently owns the primary rotation for inference incidents. If that lead moves orgs, we must ensure a documented runbook and a 6-week shadow handoff with MoUs for incident triage. I prefer a staggered handoff (lead moves but retains paging responsibility for one rotation cycle).
- Manager bandwidth: I’m nearing 9 direct reports after the change; that’s at the upper bound for effective performance management. If we proceed, I recommend creating a Senior Staff Engineer with partial managerial remit (M2IC trial) rather than expanding manager spans further.
- Tempo: avoid making role changes in the 2 weeks before major infra launch (we have a rollout on Sep 7). If we can target an Oct 1 effective date, that buys runway.

I’ll add inline edits to redline_proposal_v1.docx with specific runbook asks.

Subject: Re: Proposed reporting shift for Core Serving (confidential) — checklist and template

Hi all —

Thanks for including us. Attached is a short checklist we use for sensitive reporting changes and a draft comms template that separates manager-level notices from all-hands messaging. High-level recommendations: 

1) Pre-change: 1:1 manager outreach with a clear FAQ + one-pager on role expectations; compensation conversations scheduled only after leadership sign-off.
2) Transition: 6-week shadowing window for on-call and code ownership with a named escalation path.
3) Performance/promotions: evaluate M2IC candidates using a calibrated rubric tied to outcomes (not tenure); consider limited spot bonuses rather than immediate title changes if timing conflicts with Q4 reviews.
4) Legal/regulatory: include a clause for EU employees that allows a 30-day consultation window if required.

We recommend running manager 1:1s the week after leadership sign-off and doing a small cross-functional readout with Product/Infra before any public comms.

Attached: peopleops-org-change-checklist.pdf

Best,
Samira Khan
Principal Consultant, PeopleOps Consulting
contact@peopleops.co
